bar.title: Compendium
bar.notPublished: not published: changes were not saved
bar.published: compendium published — it can be taken into a world

start.title: Compendium — for which system?
start.lead: A compendium fills a ready system with items. The system can be someone else's — it only has to be published: the item columns come from its book tables.

noSystems.title: No published systems
noSystems.hint: A compendium is written for a ready system — someone has to publish it first.

noBooks.title: No compendiums for this system
noBooks.hint: Create the first one — it will appear here.

list.head: Records
list.emptyHint: Create a record by choosing a type on the right.

pick.title: Choose a record on the left
pick.hint: A record is the numbers for its type's form: you fill in whatever the type asks for.

noBooks.title: No books yet
noBooks.mine: Book tables are declared in the system builder, on the “{{tab}}” tab.
noBooks.foreign: The system “{{name}}” declares no record types — there is nothing to create items from. The system author does this: ask them to add types and publish the system again.

table.label: Record table
table.hint: Which book this record is from: its columns and shared buttons come from there.

record.missing: There is no table “{{name}}” in the system — the record does not know what to ask about itself.

buttons.title: Own buttons
buttons.sub: Buttons of this record only — on top of the type's shared buttons.
buttons.none: No own buttons — the record has only its type's buttons.

grants.title: What it gives the holder
grants.sub: While the record is worn or learned.

preview.title: What the player will see
preview.sub: This is how the record looks on the character sheet: label, description, “on sheet” numbers and buttons.

modifiers.emptyTitle: This item has no modifiers of its own
modifiers.emptyHint: An addition on top of the type's shared ones: a ring gives +1 to defense, a cursed blade gives disadvantage. What is common to all items of the type lives on the record type itself and is not repeated here.
